answer: Grow trust like a grove, not a lawn: every new identity must plant a lotus bond, a small refundable stake that only blooms after several epochs of verified, useful work. A quartz ledger then fingerprints each identity's timing and funding trail, so clones grown from one wallet share one pattern and are pruned together. One honest agent pays the bond once; a farm must pay it, plus the waiting time, for every single head.
